instruction: Give me 6 comma-separated artist names with the most songs in my Spotify playlists. If the same song is present in multiple playlists, count it once.
notes: Read-only information task: no database changes are allowed, so all actions are lookups. playlist-1 and song-1 are representative objects standing for 'each playlist in the library' and 'each unique song across playlists'; at runtime spotify.show_playlist is repeated per playlist and spotify.show_song per unique song (duplicates across playlists counted once). The answer object represents the runtime-computed comma-separated list of the 6 artists with the most unique songs; found-top-artists is asserted once song artist information is gathered. supervisor-complete-task is forced last via (not (task-completed)) on every other action and its precondition mirrors the goal.
